intro: Panama's economy is built on the canal, shipping, banking and trade.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: About 5% of world sea trade passes through the canal. Panama has one of the largest ship registries, and the Colón Free Zone is a huge trade hub.

chapters.title: Dollar
text: Panama has used the US dollar since 1904.

keyTerms.meaning: An area with low taxes on trade.
